title: The Remnant of Jacob: Victory Over Assyria and the Cleansing of the People
description: Micah prophesies that when Assyria attacks, seven shepherds and eight rulers will arise to devastate the land of Assyria and Nimrod. The remnant of Jacob shall be like dew from the Lord among the nations, and like a lion among flocks of sheep against their enemies. The Lord promises to destroy horses, chariots, fortresses, sorcery, soothsayers, carved images, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles from His people, and to take vengeance on the pagan nations that do not obey.
